body.quota_exhausted: This account has used up its allowance. Retry after the limit resets, or start a new session for other work.
body.rate_limit: Too many requests in a short window. Retry in a moment.
body.overloaded: The service is under heavy load. Retrying shortly usually works.
body.server_error: The server returned an internal error. Retry once; open details if it keeps failing.
body.context_length: This conversation has exceeded the model's context window. Compacting keeps the essentials and continues, or rewind to an earlier message and remove extra content.
body.network: The connection to the service was interrupted. Check your network, VPN, or proxy and retry; a brief blip resumes from current progress.
body.auth: Your credentials are missing or expired. Sign in again and retry.
body.permission_denied: This account is not allowed to make this request. Start a new session another way, or contact an administrator.
body.org_policy_denied: Your organization's policy blocks this request. An administrator needs to adjust it first.
body.org_disabled: Access for your organization has been disabled. Contact your administrator.
body.usage_policy: The message was blocked by the content policy. Rephrase it or remove related quotes, or rewind and edit the previous message.
body.image_dimension: The image is larger than the model allows. Rewind and use a smaller image.
body.image_invalid: The image could not be read or its format is unsupported. Rewind and pick another file.
body.request_too_large: The request (including attachments) exceeds the size limit. Rewind and remove some content or attachments.
body.model_not_found: The current model is unavailable or retired. Switch to another model, or start a new session.
body.output_token_limit: The answer hit the single-response output limit and was cut off. Send 'continue' to keep going, or split the task.
body.max_turns: This turn hit the tool-call turn limit and stopped. Send a message to keep going.
body.billing: A billing problem blocked the request. Check your payment details in account settings.
body.invalid_request: The server rejected the request parameters. Start a new session and retry; details hold the raw error.
body.unknown: Something unrecognized went wrong. Retry; if it keeps failing, open details and copy the raw error.

memory.modeIsolatedHint: Separate memory bank, invisible to and from global memory

memory.injectHint: How memory is injected into context each turn; off by default, lower options use fewer tokens

memory.injectNoneHint: No automatic injection; memory tools remain for on-demand use
memory.pageRefreshHint: Refresh the index block every N turns; 0 = never (the block is injected every turn by default, ~2KB)
